column1: # Case table for waived-gate.yml (a fixture; see its header).
# Rows 2, 3 and 4 are the ones the always()-only model got wrong. Row 2 is
# the waived gate substrate's rust-auto-release could not assert without a
# no-op always(). Row 3 runs a failure() job past a skipped need. Row 4
# holds an explicit success() to the implicit one: announce must skip while
# bump is skipped, although the case says success()=true.
# An operator cancel that lands after test passed must not tag.
